Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade three
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Environment Suggested vocabulary conserve, care, responsibility, natural, weathe
Topic 15.1: Listening and Speaking 15.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 15.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary, part of Environment Suggested vocabulary conserve, care, responsibility, natural, weathe in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade three ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How can we use sounds learnt to make new words?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 15.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: The learner’s ability to speak clearly and effectively is improved as they engage in meaningful conversations and

as they walk together discussing about the environment using new words.

• Critical thinking and problem solving: The learner’s research skills are enhanced as they think of how to take care of the environment.

• Learning to learn: The learner’s ability to learn independently is heightened as they recreate learning experiences outside class by taking care of the

environment.

Values:
• Responsibility: A learner takes up assigned roles when engaging in a dialogue with peers.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
• Environmental Education and Climate Change: (Nature Walk): A learner gets information on how to take care of the environment as they take part

in nature walks.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner applies attentive listening skills acquired to learning of concepts in other learning areas.

Suggested Learning Resources:

• Books with appropriate print

• Braille Books

• Flash cards

• Braille cards
